name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop app: an Electron shell that bundles a standalone Node runtime, the dsh host, and the preinstalled web profile, so the Web GUI runs with zero preinstalled tooling.
author: DeepSeek Harness Contributors

scripts.prepare-runtime: node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && node scripts/fetch-pnpm.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64
